facts.fact: Nobus Cloud Services, a Nigerian public cloud provider, went live in Kenya with a Nairobi availability zone, Nobus-EA-AZ1, letting Kenyan organisations provision workloads locally; the article calls it an availability zone, not a region, and gives no date beyond the 2026-09-09 publication.

Digital Realty (formerly iColo) opened its Nairobi Two (NBO2) colocation data centre in Karen, adding 6.4 MW to its Nairobi campus; the article gives no exact opening date, so the as_of is the publication month.

note: Nobus zone is described as an availability zone; parent should judge whether it counts as a cloud region. Oracle region only being prepared; Airtel under construction (not facts).
